text:
emma: FYI customer reported duplicate onboarding sessions + billing after a token refresh raced with a 429. sampleapp is the python quickstart. logs show client retried immediately on 429 while refresh happened.
jon: can you paste the log snippet and which sdk?
emma: python SDK v0.9.2 (quickstart). snippet: 
```
ERROR POST /v1/sessions 429 {"retry_after":0.5}
DEBUG token refresh start
DEBUG retrying POST /v1/sessions id=null
INFO POST /v1/sessions 201 id=sess_abc123
```
sahil: this is classic unsafe replay. retries without an Idempotency-Key + racey token rotation = duplicate side effects. node/go SDKs auto-idempotency for mutates; python quickstart doesn't demonstrate a header.
nina: what's our policy on defaulting idempotency in SDKs? auto-idemp can change semantics for apps that rely on multiple distinct creates.
kevin: proposal: SDK defaults = safe client backoff (exp + full jitter) but NO auto-idempotency unless endpoint opt-in via annotation. expose helper to generate headers and a convenience flag in sampleapp. config suggestion: `retry.attempts=5`, `retry.base_ms=75`, `retry.max_ms=1500`, `safe_replay_window_s=12`. pseudo: 
``n# full jitter exponential backoff
backoff = min(max_ms, base_ms * 2**attempt)
sleep = random.uniform(0, backoff)
```
emma: can we also teach onboarding about refresh races? a tiny note would have avoided this customer's confusion. I'll add an onboarding blurb and link to the retry playbook.
jon: also make the python quickstart set an Idempotency-Key in the create-session example and add a footnote about when to remove it. snippet for sampleapp: 
```python
import uuid
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())}
resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
```
sahil: we should add an e2e test that forces a 429 mid-refresh to validate sampleapp and SDK behavior. file ticket and link it in PR.
kevin: i'll pick up the python parity ticket and add a small api: Client.create_session(..., idempotency=None) where idempotency can be True/False/auto with opt-in annotation. will open RFC for review.
ci-bot: created ticket #INT-2147 for python-sdk-idempotency-parity and PR draft at github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/78
emma: perfect! i'll update onboarding doc + open the sampleapp patch to show header injection and mention recommended retry knobs. tagging this thread for the follow-up PR and tests. :+1:
